title: Walk through a hilltop city built two thousand years ago
description: Walk between enormous carved stelae, sunken tombs, and grassy plazas above a patchwork of dry valleys.

title: Eat your way through a market of smoky chiles and handmade chocolate
description: Follow smoke from dried chiles, fresh masa, cacao, and herbs through a market famous for deep, layered sauces.

title: Swim beside mineral terraces that look like frozen waterfalls
description: Float in spring-fed pools beside rippled white mineral terraces, with cactus hills and wide valleys below.

title: Meet craftspeople making carved animals and handwoven rugs
description: Visit village studios where copal creatures, indigo-dyed wool, and intricate weaving turn everyday workshops into color.

title: Build a late-night feast from tiny grills and sidewalk stalls
description: Build dinner from charcoal-grilled tasajo, blue-corn tlayudas, chapulines, and sharp local salsas after dark.

title: Walk sunset ramparts around a centuries-old walled port
description: Follow coral-stone ramparts past cannons, bougainvillea, and sea views as the Caribbean light turns coppery.

title: Explore a fortress engineered to survive pirate attacks
description: Climb massive batteries and tunnel passages built against pirate raids, with humid harbor views below.

title: Get lost among murals, balconies, and music-filled side streets
description: Wander painted wooden balconies, street murals, salsa bars, and tiny courtyards in a hot, music-soaked quarter.

title: Learn to cook with plantains, coconut, and Caribbean seafood
description: Shop for coconut, plantains, lime, and just-caught fish before cooking a bright coastal meal in someone’s kitchen.

title: Follow a drumbeat into an Afro-Caribbean music workshop
description: Learn call-and-response rhythms on hand drums, tracing African, Caribbean, and street-party traditions with local musicians.

title: Camp above the clouds beside an erupting volcano
description: Climb through pine forest to a windy volcanic ridge, then watch a neighboring cone pulse red after nightfall.

title: Walk a working coffee farm beneath a volcano
description: Walk shaded rows of bourbon coffee, smell beans roasting over fire, and taste a cup beneath a volcano.

title: Wander ruined churches shaken apart by earthquakes
description: Wander earthquake-split convents where mossy arches, empty chapels, and volcano views frame the old streets.

title: Hike across black volcanic rock while heat rises from the ground
description: Cross crunching black lava, feel heat underfoot, and toast something over vents on an active cone.

title: Browse an Indigenous market packed with textiles and produce
description: Browse dense rows of woven huipiles, avocados, flowers, and livestock as highland families shop for the week.

title: Try a three-course crawl through one of the world’s great food cities
description: Taste lime-bright ceviche, smoky anticuchos, and Chinese-Peruvian stir-fries across neighborhoods where lunch is serious business.

title: Explore an ancient adobe pyramid in the middle of a modern city
description: Enter an adobe temple of steep ramps and ancient courtyards, improbably surrounded by traffic and modern apartment towers.

title: Roam a cliffside arts district full of studios and old houses
description: Cross a cliffside footbridge past faded mansions, street galleries, ocean fog, and bars tucked into old houses.

title: Take a beginner surf lesson beneath a coastal skyline
description: Paddle into cold Pacific peelers beneath high-rise cliffs, then dry off with ceviche and a long lunch.

title: Walk balconies, catacombs, and grand squares from a colonial capital
description: Move from carved balconies and grand plazas into cool catacombs lined with old bones beneath a monastery.

title: Ride cable cars from a valley city into hillside neighborhoods
description: Float over steep brick neighborhoods in a cable car, seeing football courts, rooftops, and green mountains unfold below.

title: Climb a giant isolated rock for a lake-filled panorama
description: Climb more than 700 steps up a granite monolith for a dizzying view of flooded valleys and islands.

title: Learn a neighborhood’s transformation through its murals
description: Read towering murals with a resident guide, hearing how a once-feared hillside became a neighborhood people claim proudly.

title: Eat lunch in a sprawling indoor market
description: Choose lunch from arepas, sancocho, grilled meats, and mountains of tropical fruit at a sprawling local market.

title: Explore a public square filled with oversized bronze figures
description: Meet oversized bronze figures in a busy downtown plaza, then duck into nearby museums, cafés, and shady streets.

title: Ride a cable car into thin air and hike an Andean ridge
description: Ride from a dense capital into thin, wind-whipped grassland, then hike a ridge beneath snow-streaked peaks.

title: Walk across a high volcanic plain beneath a snowcapped summit
description: Walk a windswept páramo beneath a snowcapped giant, passing wild horses, volcanic streams, and fast-changing clouds.

title: Navigate a maze of gilded churches and colonial plazas
description: Follow steep cobbled lanes between gilded churches, carved balconies, and busy squares high in the Andes.

title: Go birding and waterfall hiking in a misty cloud forest
description: Drop from cool highlands into orchids, hummingbirds, hanging bridges, and waterfalls wrapped in constant mist.

title: Stand on the line where both hemispheres meet
description: Straddle a painted equatorial line, play with shadow experiments, and indulge in the world’s oddest geography stop.

title: Hike to the rim of a crater holding a brilliant green lake
description: Push up a steep forest trail to a crater rim, then look down on an intensely turquoise lake.

title: Trace coffee from mountain farm to fresh cup
description: Follow coffee cherries from shaded volcanic slopes to a rustic mill, ending with a cup beside drying beans.

title: Learn to press and griddle stuffed corn cakes
description: Pat warm corn dough around cheese, beans, or pork, then eat griddled rounds with tangy curtido and salsa.

title: Road-trip through mountain villages known for murals and flowers
description: Wind through flower-filled mountain towns, stopping for coffee, murals, viewpoints, and market snacks between cloud forests.

title: See carved stone ruins in a quiet jungle clearing
description: Find jaguar-shaped altars and carved stone figures in a small jungle ruin surrounded by coffee-country greenery.

title: Stand beneath a vast mural that tells a country’s history
description: Stand beneath fiery, floor-to-ceiling murals of revolution, industry, and Indigenous history inside a grand stone rotunda.

title: Join a roaring crowd for masked wrestling
description: Cheer masked heroes and villains through acrobatic throws, melodrama, and a roaring arena full of families.

title: Eat your way through a market of stews, tortas, and sweets
description: Eat tortas ahogadas dripping with chile sauce, birria broth, and sweet jericalla at noisy old market counters.

title: Browse ceramic workshops in a colorful artisan town
description: Browse painted ceramics, blown glass, and clay figures in sunlit workshops around a tiled artisan-town plaza.

title: Walk a monumental plaza of cathedrals, theaters, and arcades
description: Walk broad arcades between twin-spired cathedrals and a grand theater, pausing for fruit drinks and street snacks.

title: Take a funicular up a mountain for a city-wide view
description: Ride a funicular through eucalyptus to a hilltop church, with a vast high-altitude city spread below.

title: See a room glowing with thousands of ancient gold objects
description: Stand in a darkened room sparkling with tiny pre-Hispanic gold offerings, animal figures, and ceremonial masks.

title: Descend into an enormous underground cathedral carved from salt
description: Descend through cool mine tunnels into blue-lit salt chambers, crosses, and cathedral-scale caverns carved underground.

title: Decode a capital city through its street art
description: Read giant murals about protest, memory, and daily life while a guide explains the walls’ changing messages.

title: Sample tropical fruit you have never seen before
description: Sample lulo, guanábana, feijoa, and other unfamiliar fruit, then linger over soup and arepas with market regulars.

title: Hike through a limestone canyon beneath jagged peaks
description: Scramble past pale limestone walls and clear pools in a rugged canyon where jagged mountains crowd the city.

title: Explore bold modern art in a riverfront park
description: See bold contemporary art beside reflecting pools and industrial mountain scenery in a riverfront park built for strolling.

title: Settle in for a serious northern-style barbecue feast
description: Settle into cabrito, smoky carne asada, flour tortillas, and cold beer at a long northern-style family table.

title: Wander an old industrial complex turned into a giant public park
description: Wander brick blast furnaces, canals, sculpture lawns, and museums in a former steelworks turned enormous civic park.

title: Climb a forest trail to look over a city ringed by mountains
description: Climb a piney foothill trail at dawn for a city framed by sawtooth peaks and dry northern light.

title: Climb a hill that is actually the world’s largest pyramid
description: Enter tunnels inside a giant grassy mound, then emerge beneath a hilltop church overlooking a volcanic plain.

title: Taste the layers of a legendary slow-built sauce
description: Taste dark mole built from toasted chiles, seeds, spices, and chocolate, often spooned over tender turkey.

title: Explore hidden tunnels beneath a colonial city
description: Follow brick-lined passages beneath streets and hills, hearing stories of forts, sieges, and hidden escape routes.

title: See blue-and-white ceramics made by hand in old workshops
description: Watch artisans paint cobalt-and-white talavera, then spot the glossy tiles climbing church domes and kitchen walls.

title: Wander a city of ornate churches and candy-colored facades
description: Wander candy-colored façades, baroque churches, sweet shops, and arcaded squares where colonial grandeur feels unusually intact.

title: Race down a black volcanic slope on a wooden board
description: Hike up a black cinder cone, then fly downhill on a wooden board through loose volcanic ash.

title: Look into a volcano’s glowing lava lake after dark
description: Peer into a smoking crater after sunset, watching molten red flicker far below through sulfurous haze.

title: Roam a bright colonial city by horse-drawn carriage
description: Clip-clop past bright colonial façades, cathedral towers, mango trees, and horse-drawn carts around sun-baked plazas.

title: Boat among dozens of tiny volcanic islets
description: Boat through calm channels between volcanic islets, passing herons, monkeys, hidden homes, and lush lakeside gardens.

title: Eat a roadside breakfast of grilled corn and local cheese
description: Eat grilled corn, salty fresh cheese, plantains, and coffee at roadside stands before the town fully wakes.

title: Navigate tunnels beneath a colorful mountain city
description: Wind through former riverbeds and mining passages beneath a hillside city, emerging into narrow, brightly painted lanes.

title: Visit a museum of naturally preserved mummies
description: See naturally preserved nineteenth-century bodies in a stark museum—macabre, oddly intimate, and unmistakably memorable.

title: Descend into a silver mine that made an empire rich
description: Descend into a silver mine’s damp shafts and hear how one mountain financed palaces, churches, and empire.

title: Ride a funicular to a hilltop monument and city view
description: Ride above a maze of ocher and cobalt houses, then stand beside a giant monument over steep hills.

title: Follow music through tiny plazas and winding alleyways
description: Follow student troubadours through tiny alleys, plazas, and late-night cafés in a theatrical hilltown built for wandering.

title: Stand among finely carved monuments in an ancient jungle city
description: Walk past intricately carved stelae, pyramids, and hieroglyphic stairways beneath tropical hills and calling macaws.

title: Crawl through archaeological tunnels beneath a temple
description: Duck through protected tunnels under a temple to see painted plaster, buried stairways, and earlier building layers.

title: Walk through a tropical bird sanctuary full of scarlet macaws
description: Walk among rescued scarlet macaws in a leafy sanctuary, with mountain coffee farms and jungle calls nearby.

title: Ride horseback through coffee hills and rural villages
description: Ride gentle trails past coffee shrubs, small farms, and mountain villages, then finish with a freshly roasted cup.

title: See an ancient temple rebuilt at full scale inside a museum
description: See a temple façade reconstructed indoors, where brightly painted gods and dense carvings survive far better than outside.

title: See the machines, cars, and inventions that changed modern life
description: Board old trains, see the first moving assembly lines, and watch working machines bring industrial history to life.

title: Stand in the tiny studio where era-defining music was made
description: Stand in a tiny converted house studio where tambourines, microphones, and classic songs changed popular music.

title: See a room-sized mural cycle about workers and industry
description: Stand inside a vast mural cycle of auto workers, furnaces, and medicine painted directly onto museum walls.

title: Eat a long lunch across one of America’s great immigrant food districts
description: Share shawarma, charcoal kebabs, warm pita, garlicky dips, and syrupy pastries across busy family-run storefronts.

title: Browse a century-old public market on a busy weekend morning
description: Browse flower stalls, smoked meats, handmade pasta, and weekend crowds in a red-brick market built for regulars.

title: Walk a fortified old city above a broad river
description: Follow fortifications above a broad river, then descend steep stone lanes past slate roofs and French signs.

title: See a powerful waterfall drop beside an old city
description: Feel spray from a towering waterfall beside an old city, then cross viewpoints above a deep river gorge.

title: Warm up with a cold-weather food crawl through old stone streets
description: Warm up with meat pies, cheese curds, maple sweets, and flaky pastries in stone-walled cafés built for lingering.

title: Explore a working hilltop fortress with river views
description: Walk grassy ramparts, old barracks, and lookout towers where soldiers still train above a river bend.

title: Wander snow-dusted lanes after dark with no itinerary
description: Drift through snow-dusted lanes under gas lamps, stopping for hot drinks, small boutiques, and river mist.

title: Walk through a frozen canyon beside blue ice and waterfalls
description: Walk a narrow winter canyon beside turquoise ice, frozen waterfalls, and rushing water between sheer limestone walls.

title: Ride above a mountain town to a snowy summit panorama
description: Ride a gondola above a mountain town into snowfields and lookout decks with jagged peaks in every direction.

title: Soak in hot mineral water while snow covers the peaks
description: Soak in steaming mineral water while snow clings to the peaks, turning a cold mountain day into recovery.

title: See a turquoise glacial lake as winter takes hold
description: Walk a pale turquoise lakeshore beneath glacier-cut peaks, with early snow and impossibly clear mountain air.

title: Take a guided drive through a mountain wildlife corridor
description: Search a protected wildlife corridor for elk, bighorn sheep, and wolves while learning how mountain crossings work.

title: See the artifacts, outfits, and stories that built rock music
description: Move through guitars, stage costumes, handwritten lyrics, and giant concert artifacts in a waterfront rock shrine.

title: Hike forest-and-river trails through a national park near a city
description: Follow easy wooded trails past waterfalls, sandstone ledges, and an old canal towpath just outside the city.

title: Spend an afternoon in a world-class art museum that costs nothing to enter
description: Wander from medieval armor to luminous paintings and contemporary galleries in a grand museum with free admission.

title: Build lunch from an old indoor market’s best counters
description: Build lunch from pierogi, corned-beef sandwiches, fresh pastries, and neighborhood specialties inside an old arcade-like market.

title: See an industrial city’s warehouses become a creative district
description: Explore old warehouses reborn as galleries, coffee shops, breweries, and studios along brick streets by the river.

title: Scramble up red rock to a viewpoint above the desert
description: Scramble slick red sandstone to a wind-carved lookout, with spires, mesas, and desert sky stretching forever.

title: Hike to a natural sandstone arch at golden hour
description: Hike through juniper and red sand to a stone window that catches the last orange light of day.

title: Walk a shaded creek canyon beneath towering red cliffs
description: Trade open red desert for cottonwoods, ankle-deep crossings, and cool shade beneath towering canyon walls.

title: Look through a telescope at a truly dark desert sky
description: Look through telescopes for Saturn, nebulae, and dense constellations in a certified dark-sky desert after dinner.

title: Climb to stone cliff dwellings built long before the modern West
description: Climb to stone rooms tucked beneath a red-rock overhang, where families lived centuries before highways arrived.

title: Hike through a landscape packed with natural stone arches
description: Hike beneath dozens of gravity-defying sandstone arches, balancing rocks, and fins in a wide-open rust-colored desert.

title: Stand above a canyon maze carved by two great rivers
description: Stand above a maze of red canyons where two rivers meet, with sheer cliffs dropping away on every side.

title: Find ancient rock art beside a desert trail
description: Find petroglyph panels scratched into dark desert varnish beside a river corridor and towering canyon walls.

title: Hike beneath spires that rise straight out of the desert
description: Walk among towering sandstone needles and red cliffs, with a famous lone rock formation rising ahead.

title: Touch real dinosaur tracks pressed into ancient mud
description: Touch three-toed dinosaur tracks pressed into ancient mud, then imagine a riverbank where giant animals once wandered.

title: Hike a ridge with a river gorge unfolding below
description: Hike through hardwood forest to overlooks above a looping river gorge, bridges, and a compact city below.

title: Walk beneath a mountain through an underground waterfall cave
description: Follow lit paths through cathedral-sized caverns where an underground waterfall pours from a mountain overhead.

title: Walk a battlefield where a pivotal campaign unfolded
description: Walk ridge lines, old artillery positions, and quiet fields where a pivotal Civil War campaign turned.

title: Paddle a calm urban river beneath ridges and bridges
description: Paddle calm water past downtown bridges and wooded ridges, spotting herons while the city stays close.

title: Meet river giants and ocean creatures in a standout aquarium
description: Watch river otters, giant catfish, penguins, and reef fish in two connected aquariums built beside the river.

title: Hike up a river through a canyon so narrow the walls nearly meet
description: Wade a cool river between towering red walls that narrow to a slot, with wet feet and changing conditions.

title: Climb to a viewpoint above a vast red-rock canyon
description: Climb switchbacks to a narrow ledge above an immense canyon, where sheer red cliffs fall away below.

title: Hike a quieter canyon of rust-colored cliffs and hanging gardens
description: Leave the busy canyon for rust-colored cliffs, hanging gardens, and quieter trails beneath enormous walls.

title: See rock art panels left by people who lived in canyon country
description: See panels of bighorn sheep and human figures pecked into sandstone by people who knew this canyon country.

title: Watch canyon walls turn orange, then disappear into a dark sky
description: Watch canyon walls flare orange at sunset, then trade the last glow for silence and a star-filled sky.

title: Eat a border-city feast of burritos, tortillas, and desert spice
description: Start with red-chile burritos, flour tortillas, smoky carne asada, and desert spice at a borderland breakfast counter.

title: Climb the highest summit in a vast desert mountain range
description: Climb from cactus scrub to a windy limestone summit, where desert basins suddenly give way to alpine air.

title: Descend by natural entrance into a cathedral-sized cavern
description: Descend a natural cave entrance into gigantic chambers of stalactites, delicate formations, and deep underground quiet.

title: Hike a desert canyon that bursts into autumn color
description: Hike a seasonal creek beneath limestone cliffs, cottonwoods, and surprising autumn maples in the high desert.

title: Visit a centuries-old mission in the desert borderlands
description: Step through thick adobe walls, bell towers, and dusty courtyards where Indigenous, Spanish, and borderland histories overlap.

title: Scramble around giant boulders in a surreal desert forest
description: Scramble among giant rounded boulders and spiky desert trees, where every formation looks designed for a sci-fi set.

title: Ride a rotating tram from hot desert to alpine forest
description: Ride a rotating tram from sun-baked desert to cool pine forest, then hike beneath granite peaks and blue sky.

title: Road-trip to a surreal accidental inland sea
description: Drive past abandoned marinas, bird-filled shallows, and salty desert beaches at an accidental inland sea in crisis.

title: Tour a desert town’s mid-century modern architecture
description: Tour low-slung glass houses, palm-lined civic buildings, and playful mid-century details designed for sun and mountains.

title: Watch a desert sky fill with stars after a day on the trail
description: Stay out after desert trails cool, watching a crisp night sky fill with stars above dark mountain silhouettes.
